g.text: ELECTRICAL: SAFETY CIRCUIT, CONTROL 24 V, PLC I/O
Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-401 Servo auger filler (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: SAFETY: E-STOP + FLAP INTERLOCK → STO + AGITATOR STOP (stop category 0, PL d target)
S0 + B1 both channels in series; cross-fault detection by K1 (S11/S21 pulsed)
agitator runs only with K1 closed and Y3 on
PLC A2: CLICK C2-03CPU-2 + C0-16CDD2 (8 DI sinking/sourcing 24 V, 8 DO sourcing 0.3 A)
X1 S2 foot switch NO (start dose)
Y2 A1 CTRG start move (PR path = dose)
Y5 → H1, Y6 → H2 (pod 106), returns to 0 V
1 Power on: K1 reset (S1) → X3 = 1; PLC sets Y1 SON; X4 SRDY = 1 → H1 on, Y3 agitator on.
2 Operator selects the product on the HMI: PLC writes the PR path revs (servo counts) over Modbus.
3 Container on the nest → X2 = 1; foot switch X1 (edge) → Y2 CTRG pulse 50 ms.
4 Servo runs the dose (S 900 / J 600 rpm at the auger); X6 TPOS = 1 → dose done, count + 1.
5 Remove the container (X2 = 0) before the next dose; no dose without a container.
6 Hopper low (MES level) or X5 / X7 = 0 → stop, Y6 red, message on the HMI; Y4 ARST from the HMI.
7 E-stop or flap open → K1 drops: STO removes motor torque at once, KM1 drops; Y1 off until reset.
Dose times: shaker 1.37 s, jar 1.24 s, tub 7.4 s (P1-401-900).
1. STO wiring per the SureServo2 manual: both channels from separate K1 contacts; the drive's STO status is not used for safety.
2. Validate the safety function at commissioning (ITP T14): E-stop and flap each stop the auger and agitator; a single wire fault is detected by K1 on reset.
3. Foot switch NC contact is spare (wired to the terminal X10 for a later 2-channel start if required).
